text:
sarah.eng: quick follow-up from the all-hands — can we get a clearer timeline for APAC GPU pool scaling? wondering when customers in SG/HK can expect reduced queuing :eyes:

matt-ops: short answer: we're targeting a gradual ramp over the next 6 weeks, but depends on two things: 1) confirmed capacity shipments, 2) autoscaler stability in canary regions.

elena-infra: to add — procurement has two shipments arriving mid-week 2 and week 5. first shipment unlocks ~40% of the APAC buffer. second shipment + region-level autoscale rollout gets us to target.

sarah.eng: thanks — for the autoscaler, is that the same policy as EMEA, or a different config? any risk of noisy neighboring tenants causing rollbacks?

diego-ml: we've been testing the autoscale policy with synthetic traffic. APAC config will use slightly higher min-pool to avoid cold-starts for chat workloads. also enabling dedicated tenant isolation for Prod-critical customers.

matt-ops: noisy neighbor risk is real — we'll enable aggressive request-level routing to Dedicated for flagged high-qps tenants, and fall back to Hosted small-models if capacity low.

dennis-cto: leadership note — timeline aligns with roadmap but prioritize 1) customers with committed Dedicated contracts, 2) region beta customers. we'll hold a short sync next Tuesday to confirm cutover windows.

sarah.eng: can we document the fallback policy somewhere for customer-facing folks? want to avoid surprises when a tenant gets routed to a smaller model.

elena-infra: yes — I'll add a section in the infra runbook + a short FAQ in the console docs. provisional text: `APAC fallback policy: region -> dedicated reservation -> compatible model variant -> global fallback`.

ops-bot: deploy: canary autoscaler rollout started in ap-southeast-1 at 1778130000 — 3 nodes (rolling). :rocket:

diego-ml: will monitor latency p50/p95 and kv-cache hit rates during the canary. ping me if you see regressed gen quality.

matt-ops: action items: Elena to publish runbook updates by Thu, Diego to post canary metrics channel + checklist, Dennis to confirm customer prioritization list before Tue sync.

sarah.eng: perfect — appreciate the clarity. small ask: can we get a short API change note if routing/fallback behavior changes? some SDKs assert model names.

dennis-cto: agreed, will make a comms note.

elena-infra: filing the runbook PR now. linking in ops channel when ready. :thumbsup:
